name: Bugle Snack Mix
author: Notre Dame (Becky Collier)

ingredients.name: large bag of nacho cheese Bugles

instructions:
1. Dump everything but the popcorn oil and ranch dressing into a large trash bag.
2. Mix the popcorn oil and the ranch dressing together and pour into the trash bag.
3. Gently mix everything together.
4. Transfer to 3 ungreased large foil pans.
5. Bake at 250°F for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.
6. Cool completely and store in ziplock bags.
